entries.reason: No live JADE 2022 runtime is used: the baseline under baseline/** is stand-in output (jade-standin), ported from the reference method bodies [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:2326-2868, 6526-6942] and the model-schema transaction-agent rules [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:9794-14146]. Equivalence therefore proves facade = stand-in, not facade = JADE.
entries.actionTaken: Stand-in output is labelled in every baseline record, the baseline manifest, the WSDL header comment, the report banner and the console (AAP 0.8.3). Later runs strengthen the stand-in from the in-repo sources before each cut-over.

entries.reason: No REST path appears in the repository, so paths follow the JADE 2022 rule: the verb prefix is removed and the next letter lower-cased, primitive parameters become path segments in signature order, the single object parameter is a JSON body, and the direct form runs on port 65000 [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:82]. The relay form /<alias>/jadehttp.dll/<path>?ErewhonREST, which the jadehttp.dll setting admits [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:145], is not modelled.
entries.actionTaken: Catalogue path templates follow the rule. The facade's REST catch-all forwards the relay form and every other unmatched request to the backend unchanged (AAP 0.4.5).

entries.reason: The provider's soapAction properties are blank [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:1157], so the JADE default urn:JadeWebServices/WebServiceHTTP/<op> is applied. This disagrees with the request's statement that the repository records none: the generated consumer HTTP_ErewhonWebService records exactly this form for all 9 operations [Erewhon/ErewhonWebServiceConsumerSchema.scm:1740-1868], but it was generated from a 2023 WSDL by runtime 22.0.01 and may lag the provider.
entries.actionTaken: The catalogue, stand-in and WSDL use the default form. The facade resolves the operation by SOAPAction first, then by bounded body inspection, and forwards unresolved requests to the default target.

entries.reason: The provider's wsdl class property is empty [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:1135], the consumer's WSDL path points outside the repository [Erewhon/ErewhonWebServiceConsumerSchema.scm:1723], and the &wsdl query form is undocumented. The stand-in generates the WSDL from the catalogue: namespace urn:JadeWebServices/WebServiceHTTP/, service ErewhonWebService, document/literal wrapped, ArrayOf* types.
entries.actionTaken: contracts/wsdl/ErewhonWebService.wsdl is copied from the captured stand-in WSDL with a stand-in header comment. The facade rewrites only soap:address/@location, and WsdlContractCheck compares the facade and backend WSDLs.

entries.reason: The JADE unit tests in the reference schema [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:3284-6525] and the model schema need a JADE runtime and were not run.
entries.actionTaken: Their expected statuses and messages were traced into the stand-in and the case matrix (AAP 0.9.2), and JadeUnchangedCheck proves that no file under Erewhon/ changed.

entries.reason: _restServicesOptions 2 is unexplained [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:87], so JADE's default Microsoft JSON is assumed: \/Date(ms)\/ in UTC (_webDefaultTimeZone Etc/UTC [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:92]), __type for subclasses, nulls included, Binary as a byte array, Decimal with two decimals, and the null string as "". XML and JSONN, whether selected by a .xml/.jsonn suffix or by Accept, are neither modelled nor characterised. A request with a .xml or .jsonn suffix gets 501 with the plain-text body jade-standin: output format not modelled. The stand-in ignores Accept, so an unsuffixed or .json request gets JSON whatever Accept names. JADE gives a suffix precedence over headers, so only an unsuffixed request differs: there JADE would let Accept select XML or JSONN (AAP 0.7.1).
entries.actionTaken: The characterised forms are unsuffixed requests with no Accept header, and the .json suffix. The facade forwards every form, suffix and header unchanged.

entries.reason: The <op>Response/<op>Result wrappers, xsi:nil for null results and the exposed-properties-only rule are assumed. The consumer marks results required, xmlNillable [Erewhon/ErewhonWebServiceConsumerSchema.scm:499, 557], but types them as HTTP_DTOObject and uses older types (DTOSaleItem, tenderSaleItem) [Erewhon/ErewhonWebServiceConsumerSchema.scm:405-466].
entries.actionTaken: The stand-in follows the reference schema and the WebServiceHTTP exposure list [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:1793-1932], with DTOName and String array items [Erewhon/ErewhonWebServiceConsumerSchema.scm:148-149].

entries.reason: DTOResult is absent from the WebServiceHTTP exposure list [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:1793-1932], yet the four update operations return it [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:1236, 1252, 1276, 1292].
entries.actionTaken: The stand-in writes allErrors, allWarnings and statusCode (no guid), and conformance inventories DTOResult on SOAP with those members.

entries.reason: JADE's SOAP form for a stored String holding a character XML 1.0 cannot carry (a control character other than tab, LF and CR, a lone surrogate, U+FFFE or U+FFFF) is not recorded in the repository. postCreateAgent and postCreateClient copy every DTOAgent or DTOClient member of the JSON body into AgentTA or ClientTA and AddressTA [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:2652-2691, 2692-2731], and a JSON string carries such a character as an escape such as \u0001. No AgentTA, ClientTA or AddressTA rule rejects one [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:9823-9884, 10154-10204, 10550-10598]: they check only that the values are present, that the name is not taken and that the email matches EmailRegEx, which an email holding such a character fails [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:140, 9876-9879]. A SOAP request cannot carry such a character, because the XML request parser rejects it.
entries.actionTaken: The stand-in stores the value as the TA rules leave it and returns it unchanged over REST, JSON-escaped. Every SOAP response writes each such character as U+FFFD and keeps valid surrogate pairs, so getAgentNames, getClientNames, getAgent and getClient stay well-formed SOAP 1.1 for every caller. Names are compared exactly, so a SOAP getAgent or getClient for the U+FFFD form of such a name finds no match and returns a nil result. The baseline was re-captured from the corrected stand-in: every record is byte-identical, and baseline/manifest.json's captureCommit names the corrected stand-in's commit.

entries.reason: The loader offsets every seed date by the days from 2000-01-01 to today [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:8466-8470]. The stand-in pins today to StandIn:ReferenceDate 2026-01-01, and its clock starts at 12:00:00 UTC and advances one second per state-changing request.
entries.actionTaken: Date fields are reproducible. The set of closed tenders is unchanged because every date shifts equally, and TimeStamp values are normalised by N2. At load only PROP/70 closes into a tender sale, because the tenders on the items that close before the reference date are rejected (KL-STANDIN-TENDER-LOAD).

entries.reason: Photos load through app.loadPicture [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:8657], whose stored byte form is not visible. The test constant TestPhoto begins FF D8 FF E0 (JPEG) [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:340]. The sources also disagree on which photo is returned: the getPhoto method header says it finds the first available photo [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:6652], but its loop assigns every photo it meets, so the photo of the last retail sale with a photo wins [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:6673-6677], in the (dateSold, prefix, code) order of the client's allRetailSales [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:3241, 5195-5200].
entries.actionTaken: The raw JPEG file bytes are returned base64-encoded and compared byte for byte. On the disagreement the stand-in follows the code (last), as GetPhoto in standin/src/Erewhon.StandIn/Soap/SoapEndpoint.cs does, and case SOAP-getPhoto-02 expects Elaine Lee's last sale by date, retail item 11 [Erewhon/DataFiles/RetailSales.txt:1, 6, 13]. The JADE loop, the case and its baseline record are unchanged.

entries.reason: calculateAgentCommission computes price x rate / 100 [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:7527-7556], and JADE's Decimal assignment rounding is not stated.
entries.actionTaken: Values are rounded half away from zero to two decimals, which affects agentCommission in the sale and sale-detail DTOs.

entries.reason: The seed facts (AAP 0.9.4, 0.7.3) state 160 tenders [Erewhon/DataFiles/Tenders.txt:1-160], tender sales closed at load for PROP/70, ANQU/80, ANQU/92 and DEST/106, and getAllSales returning 19 retail and 4 tender sales. That disagrees with the model schema: loadTenders persists every row through TenderTA [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:8852-8927], which rejects a tender whose item is already closed [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:13910-13914], that is whose closure date is before the current date [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:7207-7222]. Every seed date is offset equally, so item 80 (Settee, closure November 29 1999 [Erewhon/DataFiles/TenderItems.txt:22]), item 92 (Coffee Mill, November 19 1999 [Erewhon/DataFiles/TenderItems.txt:34]) and item 106 (Camel trekking, December 12 1999 [Erewhon/DataFiles/TenderItems.txt:48]) close before the reference date, while item 70 (Castle, January 1 2000 [Erewhon/DataFiles/TenderItems.txt:12]) closes on it and is still open when its tenders load. The 60 rows on items 80, 92 and 106 [Erewhon/DataFiles/Tenders.txt:21-40, 81-100, 141-160] are rejected with "The Tender Item has already closed" [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:2872].
entries.actionTaken: TenderTA is ported as written and never bypassed, so the stand-in loads 100 tenders and closes one tender sale at load: PROP/70, won by the seeded client whose offer [Erewhon/DataFiles/Tenders.txt:137] is the highest of the item's 20 tenders [Erewhon/DataFiles/Tenders.txt:121-140]. ANQU/80, ANQU/92 and DEST/106 stay unsold, so getSale returns 404 for each, and items 64, 86, 98 and 100 stay open. getAllSales returns the 19 retail sales and the 1 tender sale, which case REST-getAllSales-01 describes. The outcome does not depend on the reference date, because every seed date shifts equally.

entries.reason: The model schema declares a String length on every attribute the REST creates and the SOAP updates assign: AgentTA and ClientTA name String[81] [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:3739, 3765]; AddressTA street, city and country String[51], phone and fax String[26], and email and webSite String[61] [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:3714-3720]. Agent, Client and Address declare the same lengths [Erewhon/ErewhonModelSchema.scm:3175-3181, 3199, 3239], and so do DTOAgent and DTOClient [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.scm:110-117, 124-131]. JADE raises an exception when a longer value is assigned, and how that exception reaches a REST or SOAP caller is not recorded in the repository. No seed agent or client value is longer than 24 characters [Erewhon/DataFiles/Agents.txt:1-8; Erewhon/DataFiles/Clients.txt:1-20], and no planned case sends a value near a limit.
entries.actionTaken: The stand-in does not model the limits. postCreateAgent, postCreateClient, updateAgent, updateAgentWithDTO, updateClient and updateClientWithDTO store an over-length value in full, after the same trimming as any other value, and answer as for any other value, so the size of a record is bounded only by the stand-in's request-body limit, Kestrel's default of 30,000,000 bytes. Each declared length is documented on the stand-in model property that holds the value.

entries.reason: The facade forwards a request line of up to 1 MiB including its CRLF and a header block of up to 1 MiB less 3 bytes, counting each header line's CRLF, with any number of headers. A larger request head is refused by the facade's Kestrel with 414 or 431 and never reaches the backend. Kestrel parses a request head only inside its request buffer, which also bounds how much of a body the facade reads ahead of a slow backend, so the bound cannot be lifted without unbounded buffering per connection. The bound is assumed to exceed every backend's own head limit. The stand-in accepts request lines up to 8 KiB, header blocks up to 32 KiB and 100 headers (Kestrel defaults). The ErewhonREST and WebServiceHTTP applications declare JADE 22.0.01 [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:89, 164], whose web-message limit MaxMessageSize defaults to 1,000,000 bytes for a single-part message. Where requests reach JADE through IIS and jadehttp.dll [Erewhon/ErehwhonExternalInterfacesSchema.ddx:145, 223], HTTP.sys limits the request line and headers together to 16,384 bytes by default (MaxRequestBytes), and IIS limits URLs to 4,096 bytes.
entries.actionTaken: The facade raises Kestrel's request-line and header-size limits (8 KiB and 32 KiB by default) to its 1 MiB request buffer and lifts the 100-header count limit, so every head within the bound is forwarded unchanged and the backend's own limits decide. A backend that accepts larger heads would need only the RequestBufferSize constant in facade/src/Erewhon.Facade/Program.cs raised.

entries.reason: The ordering check compares the commit that first added baseline/manifest.json (243bb787db7bb29f52068435958332e28e300cb5) with the oldest commit that added any facade/ path. That oldest commit is ccf809181b2780e292374896f7f0477aba3fa81e, followed by dbf83d0d705b9c94f64bbd64f6a4e60181ec38a5, both environment-setup commits made before the baseline commit. Between them they added only the two facade project files and their NuGet lock files (facade/src/Erewhon.Facade/Erewhon.Facade.csproj, facade/tests/Erewhon.Facade.Tests/Erewhon.Facade.Tests.csproj and their packages.lock.json): no facade source, configuration, Dockerfile or test code. Capture never builds or reads facade/, and no baseline commit contains a facade/ path.
entries.actionTaken: No correction attempt was possible: the check reads committed history, and only rewriting the shared branch's history could change which commit first added a facade/ path, which is not permitted. Every other commit that adds a facade/ path, starting with 455d191113aa38c8ce6c9f5e7ddd0442af2b2b38 (facade/global.json) and including every facade source, Dockerfile and test file from 18e528a5ad58cf10f73e6186abc69c6f74cddc2d onward, descends from the baseline commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor). The check still reports fail in RESULTS.md; this entry documents the observed pair.
